title: Find the Divisibility Array of a String
summary: Given a string of digits and a positive integer, generate an array where each element indicates if the prefix up to that index is divisible by the integer.
statement: Given a string of digits and a positive integer, generate an array where each element indicates if the prefix up to that index is divisible by the integer.
constraints: word is a nonempty decimal digit string and m is positive.
Output one value per prefix: one when its decimal integer is divisible by m, otherwise zero.
Do not convert the entire potentially long word to an integer.
hints: Only the prefix remainder modulo m is needed.
Appending digit d changes remainder r to (10r+d) modulo m.
Append one exactly when the updated remainder is zero.
Modular arithmetic preserves divisibility while keeping every intermediate bounded regardless of word length.
editorial: Modular arithmetic preserves divisibility while keeping every intermediate bounded regardless of word length.

tests.explanation: Running remainders show prefixes 9, 99, 998244, and 9982443 are divisible by three.
Prefixes 10 and 1010 are divisible by ten, yielding [0,1,0,1].
